verdict.rationale: PostHog documents programmatic management of experiments, holdouts and shared metrics. Its official MCP server lets agents read and write across PostHog's products, and the experiments docs say results can be read with significance. However, no evidence explicitly shows experiment results and significance data being returned through the API or MCP for an agent to summarize, so the depth of programmatic results access is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the API or MCP exposes experiment results and statistical significance, an MCP experiment-read tool listing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent summarizing experiment outcomes.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: Manage experiments, holdouts, and shared metrics programmatically from your own systems.
Create experiments, launch them, and read results with significance, replays, and exposures in view.
Once connected, your agent can read and write across PostHog's products.
